segments.sn12.18:1.2: Atha kho timbaruko paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn12.18:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho timbaruko paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn12.18:2.1: “‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan’ti?
segments.sn12.18:2.5: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkhan’ti?
segments.sn12.18:2.7: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhan’ti?
segments.sn12.18:2.9: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, natthi sukhadukkhan’ti?
segments.sn12.18:2.12: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti, na passatī’ti?
segments.sn12.18:2.13: ‘Na khvāhaṃ, timbaruka, sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
segments.sn12.18:3.1: “‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.2: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.3: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkhan’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.4: ‘Kiṃ pana, bho gotama, asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhan’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘mā hevaṃ, timbarukā’ti vadesi.
segments.sn12.18:3.5: ‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho gotama, natthi sukhadukkhan’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na kho, timbaruka, natthi sukhadukkhaṃ;
segments.sn12.18:3.7: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti, na passatī’ti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na khvāhaṃ, timbaruka, sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
segments.sn12.18:3.10: Ācikkhatu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ.
segments.sn12.18:3.11: Desetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhan”ti.
segments.sn12.18:4.1: “‘Sā vedanā, so vedayatī’ti kho, timbaruka, ādito sato ‘sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan’ti evampāhaṃ na vadāmi.
segments.sn12.18:4.2: ‘Aññā vedanā, añño vedayatī’ti kho, timbaruka, vedanābhitunnassa sato ‘paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan’ti evampāhaṃ na vadāmi.
segments.sn12.18:4.3: Ete te, timbaruka, ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.sn12.18:4.5: saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
segments.sn12.18:4.8: saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī’”ti.
segments.sn12.18:5.1: Evaṃ vutte, timbaruko paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn12.18:5.2: “abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama … pe … esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.sn12.18:5.4: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Aṭṭhame sā vedanātiādi “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan”ti laddhiyā nisedhanatthaṃ vuttaṃ.
“sā vedanā, so vediyatī”ti kho, timbaruka, ādimhiyeva evaṃ sati “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan”ti ayaṃ laddhi hoti.
Evañhi sati vedanāya eva vedanā katā hoti.
Evañca vadanto imissā vedanāya pubbepi atthitaṃ anujānāti, sassataṃ dīpeti sassataṃ gaṇhāti.
Tassa hi taṃ dassanaṃ etaṃ pareti, etaṃ sassataṃ upagacchatīti attho.
Purimañhi atthaṃ sandhāyevetaṃ bhagavatā vuttaṃ bhavissati, tasmā aṭṭhakathāyaṃ taṃ yojetvāvassa attho dīpito.
Evampāhaṃ na vadāmīti ahaṃ “sā vedanā, so vediyatī”ti evampi na vadāmi.
“aññā vedanā añño vediyatī”ti kho, timbaruka, ādimhiyeva evaṃ sati pacchā yā purimapakkhe kārakavedanā, sā ucchinnā.
Tāya pana kataṃ añño vediyatīti evaṃ uppannāya ucchedadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ sampayuttāya vedanāya abhitunnassa sato “paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan”ti ayaṃ laddhi hoti.
Evañca vadanto kārako ucchinno, aññena paṭisandhi gahitāti ucchedaṃ dīpeti, ucchedaṃ gaṇhāti.
Tassa hi taṃ dassanaṃ etaṃ pareti, etaṃ ucchedaṃ upagacchatīti attho.
Idhāpi hi imāni padāni aṭṭhakathāyaṃ āharitvā yojitāneva.
Attāva vedayatī”ti evaṃladdhiko, tasmā tāya laddhiyā “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhan”ti vadati, taṃ paṭisaṃharituṃ bhagavā “sā vedanā”tiādiṃ avoca.
Tenāha “sā vedanātiādi sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhanti laddhiyā nisedhanatthaṃ vuttan”ti.
Tatrāti yaṃ vuttaṃ “sā vedanā … pe … sukhadukkhan”ti, tasmiṃ pāṭhe.
Yaṃ panettha vattabbaṃ, taṃ anantarasutte vuttameva.
Tattha pana “vedanāto añño attā, vedanāya kārako”ti laddhikassa diṭṭhigatikassa vādo paṭikkhitto, idha “vedanā attā”ti evaṃladdhikassāti ayameva viseso.
Tenāha “evañhi sati vedanāya eva vedanā katā hotī”tiādi.
Yasmā timbaruko “vedanāva attā”ti gaṇhāti, tasmā vuttaṃ “ahaṃ sā vedanā … pe … na vadāmī”ti.
Aññā vedanātiādīsupi yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ anantarasutte vuttanayameva.

Ghaṃsitvā koṭṭetvāti yathā suvaṇṇaṃ nighaṃsitvā adhikaraṇiyā koṭṭetvā niddosameva gayhati, evaṃ parivāsavattacaraṇena ghaṃsitvā suddhabhāvavīmaṃsanena koṭṭetvā suddho eva aññatitthiyapubbo idha gayhati.
Aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesīti nāmagottena apākaṭaṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ āṇāpesi ehibhikkhuupasampadāya upanissayābhāvato.
Gaṇe nisīditvāti bhikkhū attano santike pattāsanavasena gaṇe nisīditvā.
